KnightLoader backs itself up on a schedule, tells Discord what it is doing, and goes quiet while Plex, Jellyfin or Emby is playing. One backup button now saves the whole instance, logins and pairing included, and a torrent deleted on the debrid service no longer gets stuck.

**Before you update:** the settings-only export is gone, and a settings file exported with an older version can no longer be imported. Download a backup instead: it holds everything, every stored password included, so keep it somewhere only you can read.

## ✨ Added

- **Automatic backups.** Under Settings, General, Backup & transfer, the Automatic backups switch writes the same archive as Download backup every so many days, daily unless you set another interval. The folder is yours to choose; left empty it is the `backups` folder in the data folder. KnightLoader keeps the newest seven unless you set another number and deletes only its own automatic backups. The days count from the newest backup in the folder, so a restart neither skips one nor adds one, and a failed backup shows under Settings, Health & diagnostics.
- **Discord as an event target.** Add target on the Automation page asks whether the target is Discord or any other address. A Discord webhook needs nothing but its address: each event arrives as a Discord message with the file or package name, its size and category and, for a failure, the reason, in green, red or blue. A mention in a file name pings nobody, and the webhook's token stays out of the log.
- **The category as a placeholder.** `%%task.category%%` names the category a download is filed under.
- **Quiet mode during playback.** Add your media server in the Quiet mode card under Settings, Automation, and quiet mode switches itself on while something plays there and off again about half a minute after the last stream ends. KnightLoader asks Plex, Jellyfin and Emby every ten seconds. A stream paused for more than half an hour stops counting, and streams at home can be left out.
- **Unpacking waits for the film.** While a stream counts, archives that finish downloading wait as "Waiting for playback to end" and are unpacked once it is over.
- **An upload limit for quiet mode,** the number that matters when your media server streams to someone away from home, and **Off for this stream**, which brings the usual limits back until that stream ends.
- **JDownloader updates itself.** Once a day KnightLoader asks JDownloader for an update and installs it while none of its downloads is running. The switch sits in the JDownloader backend card under Settings, General, Updates.
- **Every Unraid share in the folder chooser.** The Community Applications template has a new path, Unraid shares, which mounts /mnt/user at the same path inside the container, so the download folder can be any share. An existing container gets it when you add the path in its settings.
- **PUID and PGID.** Started without `--user`, the container gives the empty folders Docker has just created to PUID:PGID, 1000:1000 unless you set them, and then runs as that account. With `--user`, as in the Unraid template, nothing changes.
- **A compose file for other Docker hosts,** linked from the README, with notes for Synology and Proxmox.
- **The bug report shows the speed** of the last two minutes and the last hour, and every running download with its backend and its connections. Names and links stay out.
- **One card per release in What's new.** After an update the window lists every release since the one you had, each with its notes and a Go there for every change a page shows.

## 🎨 Design

- **One backup button.** Download backup saves the download list, the history, the settings, the hoster and debrid logins with header profiles, captcha keys and media server tokens, the login password, the API tokens, the scripts and the pairing. Upload backup takes it back all at once or not at all, also on a machine with another app key or none when you give the key of the instance that made it. Before it starts it says what becomes of the login, and a backup made without a login password never removes the one that is set.
- **Quiet mode has a card on the Automation page,** and media servers are added from tiles, the way a VPN is.
- **A back arrow in the folder chooser** in front of the path, where the small icon after it looked like New folder.
- **Logos on hover.** In the account and hoster pickers, a logo under the pointer turns into a solid mark, or keeps its detail in greys where an outline would be a blob.
- **Rapidgator has a sharp logo** instead of a small, blurred icon.
- **The working folder says it is optional.**
- **The extension's settings** have a Display and an In the browser card, its theme can follow your device, and its toolbar icon is the bare logo.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A torrent deleted on the debrid service is added again.** KnightLoader adds it there once more and keeps the files already here. Premiumize.me and AllDebrid could fail the task and ask for the deleted torrent again on every retry. A torrent the service loses a second time goes to the next service or the built-in client.
- **Status reads on a debrid account keep their distance on a busy machine.**
- **The desktop app applies an uploaded backup** on its next start, as the container does.
- **Click'n'Load keeps every link,** also when a site pads the first one with control characters or noise, or sends it in a post of its own. Reported in [#119](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/119).
- **Downloads keep their speed to the end.** A finished connection keeps helping a slower one, and the part of a connection a host refuses is taken over at once. Reported in [#120](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/120).
- **The `docker run` from the README works on a fresh host** without a `chown` by hand.
- **Hints that name an account name the right uid and gid.**
- **A changed quiet limit applies at once.**
- **The features of 2.1 have their dots** in What's new.
- **The container leaves update checks to the container manager.**
- **The extension's language list opens above the cards below it.**

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new and changed text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
